PathfindingTemplates — clone these Parts into your map and resize/reposition them.

Costs come from NPCConfig.PathfindingCosts:
  Road    = 0.5  (preferred — main paths between settlements)
  Indoor  = 4    (mild penalty — pathfinder routes outside unless going inside)
  Marsh   = 6    (heavy penalty — NPCs detour around)
  Anomaly = 99   (essentially impassable — NPCs treat as wall)

Workflow:
  1. Right-click a template, Duplicate.
  2. Move/scale/rotate to cover the zone.
  3. Make as many copies as you need to outline a road, fill a marsh, etc.
  4. Set CanCollide=false (already set on templates) so NPCs walk through.
  5. Group related ones into a sub-Folder if you want (e.g., MapZones/Roads).

The Label string and PassThrough flag on the child PathfindingModifier are what
matter — the Part itself is just the volume. Color/Transparency are visual hints
for editing only; turn them invisible (Transparency=1) before shipping if desired.

PassThrough=true means the part doesn't block movement at all (just adjusts cost).
PassThrough=false means it blocks unless cost is finite — used for Marsh/Anomaly/Indoor.
